Met with Annapolis Cars (SR&B Advertising) again. Avails came back on all four makes -- Subaru, Hyundai, Volvo, Genesis, each split into a 10-mile and a 5-mile ring around the Annapolis store.

For this flight we're only selling the Subaru and Hyundai audiences -- $24,000 total, split evenly between them. Volvo and Genesis stay on the table as something we can show the client for a future flight, but nothing gets billed against them this time.

No agency involved, direct with the client. Flight is September through November. This is a DC office deal.
